methodology: Base, unadjusted RPI = 25% D1 winning percentage + 50% opponents winning percentage (excluding games against the rated team) + 25% opponents opponents winning percentage. Repeated opponents are weighted per match. Non-D1 and exhibitions are excluded. NCAA bonuses/penalties and selection eligibility are not modeled.
